thread:
mia: Quick escalation 1: we pushed the Keystore role refactor at 03:10UTC and APAC edges started seeing mTLS failures. Symptoms: 502s at the proxy and logs showing 'handshake denied'. Anyone on call?

sam: I saw the spike on the latency dashboard. Which principal is getting denied?

mia: proxy service account when it tries to unwrap keys for backend TLS. Example: 
```
2026-03-18T03:44:02Z proxy-4a2b DBG tls: handshake failed peer=svc-orders.apac, err=handshake_denied, stage=unwrap-key
2026-03-18T03:44:02Z keystore-1 ERR kms: Decrypt failed Principal=svc-proxy@apac Error=AccessDenied MissingBinding
```

alex: Sounds like our RoleBinding change removed the subject in APAC. We rolled the group binding but cluster-scoped subjects may vary per cluster.

priya: Can someone query the KMS audit for Decrypt requests from svc-proxy@apac between 03:00-04:00? If we see 403s that's the cause. KMS audit URL: https://console.internal/kms/audit?q=Decrypt

mia: KMS audit doesn't show any decrypt entries for that principal in APAC. Two possibilities: 1) keystore service rejected before calling KMS (RBAC check in keystore code), 2) network/routing prevented call reaching KMS and our audit sink dropped it.

ben: Check keystore logs for internal RBAC decision: we added an early-authorize step that returns deny if RoleBinding not present to avoid wasted calls. grep for 'rbac-check' in keystore logs.

mia: Found it: 
```
2026-03-18T03:43:59Z keystore-1 INFO rbac-check: principal=svc-proxy@apac check=decrypt result=DENY reason=rolebinding-not-found
```

ops-oncall: I can revert the rolebinding in APAC. Before rollback, capture artifacts: kube-audit event for RoleBinding, keystore logs, proxy envoy logs, and the output of `kubectl get rolebinding -n infra -o yaml keystore-svc-binding`.

alex: Also capture TLS artefacts: peer_cert_sha256, SNI and `X-Forwarded-Client-Cert` if present. Quick helper: 
```
kubectl -n infra logs proxy-4a2b --since=15m | jq -r '.fields.peer_cert_sha256, .fields.sni' | sed -n '1,10p'
```

priya: Opening incident. security-bot: create INC ticket and page oncall.

security-bot: Incident INC-2026-046 opened: 'APAC inbound mTLS failures after keystore role refactor'. PagerDuty notified.

ops-oncall: Rolling back binding now. Commands: 
```
kubectl --context=apac-cluster -n infra apply -f /manifests/keystore/keystore-binding-2026-02.yaml
kubectl rollout restart deploy/keystore -n infra
```

ben: Add a temporary debug flag to keystore to emit `rbac_subjects` and `rbac_eval_trace` in logs at INFO so we can see why it decided DENY. That'll help for postmortem.

mia: Patch applied, restarted keystore. Watching metrics...

~6 minutes later~

sam: handshake failure rate dropped from ~4% to 0.1% in APAC. Looks resolved.

alex: Good. Follow-ups: 1) Update RoleBinding manifest to include explicit SA subjects for every region (don't rely solely on GroupBinding), 2) add a preflight step in the RBAC CI pipeline that runs `keystore --canary-decrypt --principal svc-proxy@<cluster>` to validate decrypt permission in-cluster, 3) improve keystore logging to include `kms_request_id`, `rbac_eval_trace`, and `keystore_cache_hit`.

priya: Also we should harden our KMS audit sink so that decrypt attempts (even if denied by keystore pre-check) are logged with request metadata. Retention for these logs should be 90 days for incident correlation.

ben: Short-term alert rule suggestion: alert if mtls_handshake_refused_total{region="apac"} > 5 for 5m OR mtls_handshake_denied_rate{region="apac"} > 0.5% for 3m -> page. Include runbook checks: `kubectl get rolebinding -n infra keystore-*`, `kubectl logs deploy/keystore -n infra | grep rbac-check`, and check KMS audit for Decrypt entries.

mia: I'll open the PR to: add explicit SA subjects, add canary decrypt job to the RBAC pipeline, and add the keystore telemetry fields. Assignments: mia -> PR + rollout notes; alex -> canary decrypt runner + runbook update; priya -> KMS audit sink improvements; ben -> alert and dashboard updates.

security-bot: Reminder: link the incident timeline and logs to the PR. If outage >5m include customer-impact note.

mia: thanks folks. We'll do a short blameless postmortem focused on policy drift and CI preflight gaps.

sam: one more ask: add an integration test that simulates rolebinding churn (create/delete) and verifies a test proxy can still decrypt via KMS. That'll catch future changes.
